title: SecureEWS: Auditable data-minimization stress tests for educational early-warning systems
description: Source code, frozen protocols, aggregate results, paired-bootstrap draws, verification reports, and manuscript materials for a post-development stress test of educational early-warning data-minimization claims across review budgets, stages, excluded feature blocks, and metrics. Raw or processed row-level data, individual predictions, trained models, and XuetangX files are not included. Code: MIT; documentation and aggregate research materials: CC BY 4.0.
